description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable endoribonuclease activity and mRNA binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle and negative regulation of cell growth. Located in P-body and nucleoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: May regulate cell growth likely by suppressing RB1 phosphorylation (PubMed:19531561). May function as RNase and regulate the levels of target RNA species (Potential). In association with ZC3H12A enhances the degradation of interleukin IL-6 mRNA level in activated macrophages (PubMed:26134560). Serve as a tumor suppressor in certain leukemia cells (PubMed:17210687). Overexpression inhibits the G1 to S phase progression through suppression of RB1 phosphorylation (PubMed:19531561).
